name: Abomination
definition: This Villain gets +Attack equal to the printed Attack of the Hero in the HQ space beneath it. (Variants: Ultimate/Highest/Sewers/Double Abomination.)

name: Antics
definition: You can use a card's Antics abilities only if you have at least three cards that cost 1 or 2 and/or have Size-Changing.

name: Artifact
definition: An Artifact you play stays in front of you and gives its effect (usually once per turn) every turn, instead of going to your discard pile at end of turn.

name: Astral Plane
definition: A single space to the right of the Villain Deck. A Villain in the Astral Plane has no physical form and can only be fought with Recruit, not Attack.

name: Berserk
definition: Discard the top card of your deck; you get +Attack equal to its printed Attack. (On an Enemy, you discard when you try to fight it, and fail if you can't match the new Attack.)

name: Blood Frenzy
definition: You (on a Hero) or this Villain gets +1 Attack for each different VP value among cards in your Victory Pile.

name: Bribe
definition: You can fight villains with the keyword "Bribe" by spending any combination of Attack and/or Recruit points.

name: Burning Shards
definition: Once this turn, you may spend that many Shards to do the listed effect.

name: Burrow
definition: Burrow" means: "Fight: If the Streets were empty, put this Villain back into the Streets.

name: Celestial Boon
definition: A permanent bonus that helps you for the rest of the game, as long as the Celestial that granted it stays in your Victory Pile.

name: Charge
definition: Ambush: Charge one space" means "(After this Villain enters the Sewers,) it charges forward an extra space, pushing other Villains forward.

name: Cheering Crowds
definition: You may play this card twice in a row if you return a Bystander from your Victory Pile to the bottom of the Bystander Stack.

name: Chivalrous Duel
definition: To fight an enemy with "Chivalrous Duel," you can only use Attack from a single Hero Name.

name: Circle of Kung-Fu
definition: 5th Circle of Kung-Fu" means "During your turn, this Villain has +5 Attack unless you reveal a Hero that costs 5 or more.

name: Clone
definition: You may gain another copy of this card from the HQ. If there are none in the HQ, you may gain a copy from the Hero Deck and shuffle it.

name: Command
definition: A Villain "Commands" its group while it is the leftmost Villain of that group in the city, gaining the listed Command abilities.

name: Conqueror
definition: A Villain with "[Space] Conqueror N" gets +N Attack while any Villain (itself or another) is in that city space.

name: Contest of Champions
definition: Each player reveals a card and scores its printed cost (doubled if the chosen colour); Evil scores from the Hero Deck. Highest score(s) win the contest, everyone else loses, with the card's listed outcomes.

name: Coordinate
definition: During another player's turn you may discard a Coordinate card (then draw a replacement) to let that player play a copy of it. (Solo: discard to draw.)

name: Cosmic Threat
definition: This enemy has very high Attack but gets -3 Attack (once per turn) for each card of a listed colour you reveal, letting you cut its Attack down before you fight it.

name: Cross-Dimensional Rampage
definition: Cross-Dimensional (Character) Rampage" means "Each player reveals one of their (Character) Heroes or a (Character) card in their Victory pile or gains a Wound.

name: Cyber-Mod
definition: You may use a Cyber-Mod ability only if you have a card of the listed Hero Class in your Victory Pile.

name: Danger Sense
definition: Reveal the top N cards of the Villain Deck; you get +1 Attack for each Villain revealed, then put them all back on top in any order.

name: Dark Memories
definition: You (on a Hero) or this enemy gets +1 Attack for each Hero Class present among cards in your discard pile.

name: Demolish
definition: Demolish each player" means "Reveal the top card of the Ally (Hero) Deck, note its cost, and put it on the bottom of the Ally Deck.

name: Demonic Bargain
definition: That player discards the top card of their deck to see if they are corrupted by power. If that discarded card costs 1 or more, that player is too powerful and arrogant to resist temptation and gains a Wound, to the demon's delight.

name: Digest
definition: Use this Digest ability only if you have at least that many cards in your Victory Pile.

name: Divided
definition: A Divided Card has two mini-cards printed on it. Pay its single cost to recruit it; when you play it, choose one side and ignore the other. It still counts as one card.

name: Dodge
definition: Dodge" means "During your turn, you may discard this card from your hand to draw another card.

name: Dominate
definition: The enemy puts the named Heroes under itself and gets +1 Attack for each. When it is fought, those Heroes go to players' discard piles; if it escapes, they go to the Escape Pile.

name: Double-Cross
definition: Double-Cross each player" means each player reveals their hand and discards one of their highest-cost "doubles" (a card sharing a cost with another card in their hand).

name: Elusive
definition: Elusive 6" means "You can only fight this Adversary if you have made at least 6 Recruit this turn.

name: Empowered
definition: You (on a Hero) or this enemy gets +1 Attack for each card of the listed Hero Class currently in the HQ.

name: Excessive Kindness
definition: Works like Excessive Violence, but you trigger it by spending 1 Recruit more than you need when recruiting a Hero.

name: Excessive Violence
definition: Once per turn, spend 1 Attack more than you need to defeat an enemy to trigger all Excessive Violence abilities on cards you've already played this turn.

name: Explore
definition: Put a Hero from the HQ on the bottom of the Hero Deck. Reveal the top two cards of the Hero Deck and choose which one refills the empty HQ space. Put the other on the bottom of the Hero Deck.

name: Fail
definition: On a Berserk Enemy: do this "Fail" effect if the Berserk Attack bonus causes you to fail to defeat it.

name: Fated Future
definition: When you play a card with Fated Future, you may put it on the bottom of your deck.

name: Fateful Resurrection
definition: On a Villain card, "Fight: Fateful Resurrection" means "Fight: Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck.

name: Feast
definition: Feast" = "Fight: KO the top card of your deck.

name: Fight or Fail
definition: Do this effect whether you defeat the enemy or the Uru-Enchanted Weapons / Berserk bonus cause you to fail to defeat it.

name: Focus
definition: The new "Focus" keyword lets you transform your Recruit Points into powerful, flexible effects.

name: Fortify
definition: A Villain effect that locks down a place (e.g. "the Mastermind can't be fought while fortified"); fight that Villain to end the Fortify effect.

name: Haunt
definition: Tuck this Villain beneath that Hero, 'Haunting' it, so you can see the Villain's name. Players can't recruit the Haunted Hero while the Haunting Villain is under it.

name: Heist
definition: Once per turn you may attempt a Heist: count your different non-zero Hero costs this turn (Heist Count) vs the top Villain card's VP. Higher = use all Heist effects; tie = nothing; lower = gain a Wound.

name: Hidden Witness
definition: This means the Villain captures the top 2 cards of the Bystander Stack, face-down, as Hidden Witnesses.

name: Human Shields
definition: "Captures 2 Human Shields" means the Villain takes the top 2 Bystanders face-down; you can't fight it until you pay its Attack to rescue each Shield at random.

name: Hunt for Victims
definition: KO a Bystander that is captured by any Enemy or from the Escape Pile. If you can't, then this captures a Bystander instead.

name: Hydra Level
definition: The Hydra Level is the number of S.H.I.E.L.D. and/or HYDRA cards in the Escape Pile.

name: Hyperspeed
definition: Reveal the top N cards of your deck; you get +1 Attack for each card with an Attack icon revealed, then discard them all. (Some cards do this for Recruit instead.)

name: Indigestion
definition: If you don't have enough cards in your Victory Pile to use a card's Digest ability, use its Indigestion ability instead.

name: Investigate
definition: Look at the top two cards of your deck, reveal and draw one matching the stated trait, and put the rest back on top and/or bottom in any order.

name: Last Stand
definition: You (on a Hero) or this Villain gets +1 Attack for each empty space in the city.

name: Liberate
definition: You get +N Attack that can only be spent against Villains holding Bystanders or against the Mastermind.

name: Lightshow
definition: Once per turn, if you played at least two Lightshow cards this turn, you may use a single Lightshow ability from one of them.

name: Man Out of Time
definition: After you use this card's abilities, set it aside. At the beginning of your next turn, play this card a second time then discard it." The card is discarded the second time you play it, so you play the card only twice total. Play your returning Man Out of Time cards after the "Play a Villain Card"

name: Microscopic Size-Changing
definition: Like Size-Changing, but the cost drops 2 for each matching card played this turn (up to the icons shown) — and it can go negative, giving you points.

name: Momentum
definition: This Villain gets +N Attack if it entered another city space this turn (by moving, being pushed, or a special ability).

name: Moonlight & Sunlight
definition: Moonlight abilities work only when most of the Heroes in the HQ have odd-numbered costs. Likewise, Sunlight abilites work only when most of the Heroes in the HQ have even-numbered costs.

name: Outwit
definition: You can use this Outwit ability only if you reveal Heroes with 3 different costs.

name: Patrol
definition: Some cards have abilities like "Patrol the Sewers: If it's empty, rescue a Bystander."

name: Phasing
definition: During your turn, if a Phasing card is in your hand, you may swap it with the top card of your deck. This isn't playing or drawing a card.

name: Piercing Energy
definition: Spend Piercing points equal to an enemy's printed VP to defeat it, ignoring its Attack, Attack modifiers, and special fight conditions.

name: Prey
definition: This Villain moves in front of the player with the fewest of a named class. If no one defeats it by the end of that player's turn, it does its "Finish the Prey" effect against them.

name: Revenge
definition: For Villain groups that have the Revenge ability, each Villain gets +1 Attack for every Villain of that group in your Victory Pile.

name: Rise of the Living Dead
definition: Each player checks the top card of their Victory Pile. If that card is a Villain with a 'Rise of the Living Dead' ability, that Villain reenters the city." (Mastermind Tactics never return this way.) If you put a Villain with Bystanders into your Victory Pile, you choose the order.

name: Ritual Artifact
definition: An Artifact you may discard to get its effect, but only if you've met its listed Ritual condition this turn (e.g. "if you drew a card").

name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Clearance
definition: To fight a Villain with S.H.I.E.L.D. Clearance you must discard a S.H.I.E.L.D. (or HYDRA) Hero as an extra cost. Double Clearance needs two.

name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Level
definition: Your S.H.I.E.L.D. Level is the number of S.H.I.E.L.D. and/or HYDRA cards in your Victory Pile.

name: Savior
definition: Use this ability if you have at least 3 Bystanders in your Victory Pile." If you defeat a Villain with Bystanders, put those Bystanders into your Victory Pile before checking any Savior ability on that Villain. If a Hero card rescues a Bystander, that Bystander counts towards any Savior ability on

name: Shards
definition: Spend a Shard for +1 Attack (then return it). Villains and Masterminds get +1 Attack per Shard on them; take one of their Shards when you defeat/fight them.

name: Shatter
definition: Halve the target enemy's current Attack (round up) until end of turn. Can be repeated. On a Hero in the HQ it halves the current cost instead.

name: Size-Changing
definition: Recruit this Hero (or fight this Villain) for 2 less if you played a card of the listed Hero Class this turn.

name: Smash
definition: You may discard another card from your hand; if you do, you get the listed +Attack (e.g. "Smash 3" = +3 Attack).

name: Soaring Flight
definition: Soaring Flight" means "When you recruit this Hero, set it aside.

name: Soulbind
definition: If you have played a Hero earlier this turn, you may choose a face up Villain card from your Victory Pile, turn it face down, and put it on the bottom of your Victory Pile. If you do, then do the listed Soulbind effect.

name: Spectrum
definition: Some cards have abilities like "Spectrum: Draw a card." You can use a card's Spectrum abilities only if you have at least 3 classes of Hero. Grey S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Striker
definition: It means "This gets +1 Attack for each Master Strike in the KO pile and/or stacked next to the Mastermind.

name: Switcheroo
definition: This means "You can reveal this card from your hand and put it on the bottom of the Hero Deck.

name: Symbiote Bond
definition: This means stack this card onto the specified Villain, combining them into a single Villain with both cards' Attack and text added together.

name: Tactical Formation
definition: You can use this ability only if you have two Heroes that cost 4 and one Hero that costs 5.

name: Teleport
definition: Instead of playing, you may set aside a card with the keyword "Teleport".

name: Throne's Favor
definition: if you have the Throne's Favor, you may give it up to use the listed ability.

name: Thrown Artifact
definition: An Artifact you "throw" by putting it on the bottom of your deck to use its ability. You can throw any number on your turn.

name: Transform
definition: A card that transforms is swapped for its set-aside "Transformed" version, which you may play immediately. (Transforming Masterminds flip between two sides.)

name: Triggered Artifact
definition: An Artifact that gives its listed effect every time its trigger happens (e.g. "whenever you draw a card, +1 Attack") while you control it.

name: Undercover
definition: Put that Hero into your Victory Pile. It's worth 1VP.

name: Unleash
definition: Return that Hero from your Victory Pile to your hand.

name: Uru-Enchanted Weapon
definition: When you try to fight an enemy that has some number of Uru-Enchanted Weapons, reveal that many cards from the top of the Adversary Deck.

name: Versatile
definition: When you play a card with the keyword "Versatile" you must first choose between Recruit and Fight.

name: Villainous Weapon
definition: the Weapon is captured by the Villain in the city that's closest to the Villain Deck. If there are no Villains in the city, then KO the Weapon instead.

name: Waking Nightmare
definition: Discard a non-grey Hero from your hand. If you discard a Hero this way, draw a card.

name: Wall-Crawl
definition: When you recruit this Hero, you may put it on top of your deck.

name: Weapon X Sequence
definition: you get + Attack equal to the longest sequence of different printed cost numbers on your cards.

name: What If...?
definition: Choose a Hero Class or Hero Name. Then reveal the top card of your deck, and either put it back on top of your deck or discard it. If the revealed card had the Hero Class or Hero Name you chose, then do the What If effect.

name: When Recruited
definition: Use this "When Recruited" ability immediately when you recruit this Hero.

name: Worthy
definition: You are Worthy if you have a Hero that costs 5 or more.

name: Wounded Fury
definition: When a Hero card says "Wounded Fury", it means "You get +1 Attack for each Wound in your discard pile.

name: X-Gene
definition: You may use a card's X-Gene ability only if you have a card of the specified Hero Class in your discard pile (once per card, regardless of how many).

name: X-Treme Attack
definition: X-Treme" means "This Adversary gets +1 Attack for each other Adversary in the city with X-Treme Attack.
